<page>
 Brazoria County District Court
 Cause No. 2024-CV-0007
 Caleb Peterson, Plaintiff, v. Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance, Defendant
 Defendant's Original Answer
Date:
1-14-25
Counsel for defendant:
Richard Marshall, Ashford & Lyle LLP
Defendant generally denies each and every allegation contained in Plaintiff's Original Petition and demands strict
proof thereof by a preponderance of the evidence, as required by the Texas Rules of Civil Procedure.
For its first affirmative defense, Defendant asserts that the collision was caused, in whole or in part, by Plaintiff's own
negligence, including failure to keep a proper lookout, faliure to yield the right-of-way, and drivnig at a speed greater
than was reasonable and prudent under the conditions then existing. Under Chapter 33 of the Texas Civil Practice
and Remedies Code, any recovery must be reduced by the percentage of responsibliity attributed to Plaintiff.
For its second affirmative defense, Defendant asserts proportionate responsibility under Chapter 33, and requests
that the trier of fact determine the percentage of responsibiltiy of each claimant, defendant, settling person, and
responsible third party, and that any judgment be limited accordingly.
For its third affirmative defense, Defendant asserts that Plaintiff failed to mitigate damages by failing to follow
reasonable medical advice and by incurring medical expenses that were not reasonable or necessary. Defendant
reserves the right to amend this answer as discovery proceeds.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
